fullCourseName: Continuous course @ HAMK: Introduction to mobile robotics, 3 ECTS
shortDescription: Learn Python by programming HAMK’s real mobile robot: movement, sensors, line following and debugging. Continuous, self-paced study through Moodle.
fullDescription: Learn Python by controlling a real mobile robot in HAMK’s robotics laboratory at Riihimäki campus. The lunar-themed track and Artemis rover missions take you from basic movements to functions, loops, sensor data, colour recognition, feedback controllers and debugging. No previous coding experience is required. This continuous, self-paced 3 ECTS course has six modules, 29 core activities and an optional Sandbox, with no separate exam or scheduled Zoom sessions. Open each activity from Moodle: LTI signs you in automatically, without a separate Ondroid account or group key. Practise in the simulator, then verify your code on the physical robot to receive your Moodle grade. Ondroid retains its existing 70% participation-certificate threshold.
requirements: No previous programming or robotics knowledge is required.
